nodes.description: Constant uint256 MAX_SUPPLY = 10000, the hard cap on total Rabbots supply.
Constant uint256 RESERVED_SUPPLY = 350, the number of tokens reserved for the owner and the offset added to random indices.
Internal uint256 _price, the per-token mint price set by beginSale.
Private uint nonce, incremented on every randomIndex call and used as randomness entropy.
Fixed-size uint array indices[MAX_SUPPLY-RESERVED_SUPPLY] implementing the shuffled index mapping used by randomIndex.
Internal string _baseTokenURI, the base metadata URI returned by _baseURI.
Public uint256 numTokens, the number of tokens minted or reserved so far.
Internal bool baseURISet flag, required to be true before the sale can begin.
Public bool saleHasBegun flag gating public minting and freezing owner configuration.
Public address _vault, the destination of withdrawn funds, set by the owner.
Public payable mint(uint256 numToMint): validates sale state, supply limits and payment, then mints numToMint pseudorandom token ids to msg.sender.
Internal randomIndex(): derives a pseudorandom index from nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty and block.timestamp and performs the swap-and-pop index shuffle.
External view getPrice() returning the current _price.
Internal view _baseURI() override returning _baseTokenURI.
Owner-only setBaseURI(string baseTokenURI): sets _baseTokenURI and baseURISet before the sale begins.
Owner-only reserve(uint256 numToReserve): mints reserved tokens (ids above numTokens) up to RESERVED_SUPPLY before the sale begins.
Owner-only setVault(address newVaultAddress): assigns the withdrawal vault address.
Owner-only beginSale(uint256 price): validates vault and base URI, sets _price and flips saleHasBegun.
Owner-only withdrawFunds(uint256 amount): forwards the requested amount of ether to _vault with a low-level send.
Rabbots constructor: initializes the ERC721 name/symbol and sets numTokens to 0.
Inherited internal ERC721 _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId): validates, calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook, updates balances/owners and emits Transfer.
Inherited private ERC721 _checkOnERC721Received: if the recipient is a contract, performs an external onERC721Received call and validates the returned selector.
Ownable modifier onlyOwner: requires owner() == _msgSender(), gating all privileged Rabbots functions.
Caller-controlled msg.sender, used as mint recipient, randomness entropy and access-control subject.
Miner-influenced block.timestamp used as entropy in randomIndex.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty, block.timestamp)) in randomIndex: predictable/weak randomness seeded with caller and miner-influenced values.
payable(_vault).send(amount) in withdrawFunds: low-level value transfer that forwards only 2300 gas and returns a boolean.
External call IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(_msgSender(), from, tokenId, _data) in _checkOnERC721Received: untrusted callee can reenter during safe transfer/mint.

Arithmetic in randomIndex: index = hash % totalSize with totalSize = MAX_SUPPLY - numTokens, plus indices[totalSize - 1] accesses; vulnerable to modulo-by-zero / index underflow when supply is exhausted.
Arithmetic in mint: msg.value >= _price * numToMint and numTokens + numToMint <= MAX_SUPPLY supply accounting computations.
Parameter uint256 numToMint of mint, the number of tokens requested by the caller.
Parameter string baseTokenURI of setBaseURI, assigned to _baseTokenURI.
Parameter uint256 numToReserve of reserve, the number of reserved tokens to mint.
Parameter address newVaultAddress of setVault, assigned to _vault.
Parameter uint256 price of beginSale, assigned to _price.
Parameter uint256 amount of withdrawFunds, the ether amount forwarded to _vault.
Local variable uint id in mint holding the randomIndex result passed to _mint.
Loop counter uint256 i in mint.
Local variable uint totalSize in randomIndex, equal to MAX_SUPPLY - numTokens.
Local variable uint index in randomIndex, the modulo-reduced random array position.
Local variable uint value in randomIndex, the swapped index returned (offset by RESERVED_SUPPLY).
Loop counter uint256 i in reserve.

edges.reason: mint uses msg.sender as the recipient of _mint, so caller identity flows into token ownership assignment.
randomIndex mixes msg.sender into the keccak256 entropy, allowing the caller to influence the pseudorandom output.
randomIndex seeds keccak256 with block.timestamp, making token ids miner-manipulable timestamp-dependent randomness.
block.timestamp is a direct input to the weak randomness computation.
msg.sender is a direct input to the weak randomness computation.
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender() to enforce privileged access.
setBaseURI is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
reserve is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setVault is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
beginSale is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawFunds is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes the untrusted recipient's onERC721Received, an external callback that can reenter the contract during safe transfers.
mint calls randomIndex inside its minting loop to obtain each token id.
mint calls the inherited _mint to create each token for msg.sender.
reserve calls the inherited _mint to create reserved tokens for the owner.
withdrawFunds performs the low-level send to _vault.
randomIndex computes index = hash % totalSize and accesses indices[totalSize - 1], which can divide by zero or underflow when numTokens reaches MAX_SUPPLY.
randomIndex builds the keccak256 randomness from nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty and block.timestamp.
mint evaluates _price * numToMint and numTokens + numToMint <= MAX_SUPPLY payment and supply arithmetic.
_price is multiplied by numToMint in the payment validation arithmetic.
numToMint participates in the _price * numToMint multiplication and the MAX_SUPPLY bound check.
mint reads _price to validate that msg.value covers the requested tokens.
getPrice returns the current _price value.
beginSale writes the new _price after validating the minimum price.
mint reads and increments numTokens while enforcing the MAX_SUPPLY bound.
reserve reads and increments numTokens while enforcing the RESERVED_SUPPLY bound.
randomIndex derives totalSize from MAX_SUPPLY - numTokens, reading numTokens.
mint requires saleHasBegun to be true before minting is allowed.
setBaseURI requires that saleHasBegun is still false.
reserve requires that saleHasBegun is still false.
beginSale requires saleHasBegun to be false and then sets it to true.
mint enforces the MAX_SUPPLY constant against numTokens and numToMint.
randomIndex computes totalSize as MAX_SUPPLY - numTokens.
reserve bounds numTokens + numToReserve by the RESERVED_SUPPLY constant.
randomIndex offsets the returned index by RESERVED_SUPPLY.
randomIndex reads and increments the nonce as part of the randomness entropy.
randomIndex reads and writes the indices array during the swap-and-pop shuffle.
_baseURI returns the stored _baseTokenURI string.
setBaseURI writes the provided URI into _baseTokenURI.
setBaseURI sets baseURISet to true after storing the URI.
beginSale requires baseURISet to be true before the sale can start.
setVault overwrites the _vault address used for withdrawals.
beginSale requires that _vault is not the zero address.
withdrawFunds requires a valid _vault and sends funds to it.
numToMint parameter drives the minting loop bound and validation checks in mint.
baseTokenURI parameter is the string stored by setBaseURI.
baseTokenURI parameter is assigned into the _baseTokenURI state variable.
numToReserve parameter drives the reserve minting loop and bound checks.
newVaultAddress parameter is stored by setVault.
newVaultAddress parameter is assigned into the _vault state variable.
price parameter is validated and stored by beginSale.
price parameter is assigned into the _price state variable.
amount parameter is the value forwarded to _vault by withdrawFunds.
Local id holds the randomIndex result and is passed to _mint inside mint.
Loop counter i controls the minting loop iterations in mint.
totalSize is computed from MAX_SUPPLY - numTokens and drives the modulo and swap logic.
index is the modulo-reduced random slot used for array shuffling in randomIndex.
value holds the shuffled index that is offset by RESERVED_SUPPLY and returned.
Loop counter i controls the reserve minting loop iterations.

normalization_plan.reason: The numToMint parameter only carries caller input into mint's validation and loop, so it is merged into the mint function node.
The baseTokenURI parameter exists solely as input to setBaseURI before being stored, so it is merged into setBaseURI.
The numToReserve parameter only feeds reserve's bounds checks and minting loop, so it is merged into reserve.
The newVaultAddress parameter is only consumed by setVault when writing _vault, so it is merged into setVault.
The price parameter is only consumed by beginSale for validation and assignment to _price, so it is merged into beginSale.
The amount parameter is only consumed by withdrawFunds when forwarding ether to _vault, so it is merged into withdrawFunds.
Local id is an intermediate result inside mint's loop and is merged into the mint function node.
Local loop counter i exists only to drive mint's minting loop, so it is merged into mint.
Local totalSize is an intra-function computation of randomIndex, so it is merged into randomIndex.
Local index is an intra-function computation of randomIndex, so it is merged into randomIndex.
Local value is an intra-function computation of randomIndex, so it is merged into randomIndex.
Local loop counter i exists only to drive reserve's minting loop, so it is merged into reserve.
